title.en: MALACAÑÁN PALACE BY THE PRESIDENT OF THE PHILIPPINES AMENDING EXECUTIVE ORDER NUMBERED THREE HUNDRED AND THIRTY-ONE, EXECUTIVE ORDER NUMBERED THREE HUNDRED AND FORTY-THREE AND FOR OTHER PURPOSES.

text.en:
Section 1 of Executive Order No. 343, dated
August 14, 1950, is hereby amended by increasing and
setting up new ceiling price for Golden State Powdered
Milk as follows:
FOODSTUFF (IMPORTED)
price ceiling price
Milk Powdered:
Golden State
. 12/1-1b. P17.28/cs. P18.74/cs. P1.75/tin
SEc. 3. Any commodity not included in any previous
Executive Order fixing ceiling prices and issued by author-
ity of Republic Act No. 509, or in this Order, the size
and specification of which are the same as those of the
foregoing, shall have the same ceiling price.
SEc. 4. The ceiling prices fixed in this Order include the
7 per cent sales tax and 1 per cent municipal tax.

This Order shall take effect five days from the
date hereof.
Done in the City of Manila, this 10th day of February,
in the year of Our Lord, nineteen hundred and rfty-one,
and of the Independence of the Philippines, the fifth.
ELPIDIO QUIRINO
President of the Philippines
By the President:
TEODORO EVANGELISTA
Executive Secretary
